column1: # ZAP baseline rules (CI job `zap`). Format: rule id <TAB> IGNORE|WARN|FAIL <TAB> (name).
# With `fail_action: true` any alert not listed as IGNORE fails the job. Only findings that were
# reviewed and are not a risk go here, each with its reason. See docs/security.md.
# Informational: Vite serves files with `Cache-Control: no-cache` (revalidate); nothing private is cached.
# False positive: large numbers inside third-party code in the minified bundle, not server timestamps.
# False positive: words like "user" in minified library code; the build strips source comments.
# Informational: tells ZAP the target is a single-page app; the job already runs the AJAX spider (-j).
